title: Kidnapped Woman Realizes Fake Uber Driver is Her Ex-Boyfriend
description:
An Arizona woman's quick thinking led to the arrest of her alleged kidnapper, her ex-boyfriend Jacob Wilhoit, 41, who posed as her Uber driver in a wig. Bodycam footage captures the dramatic traffic stop where deputies and state troopers apprehended Wilhoit after the victim slipped a desperate 911 note to a gas station customer. What unfolds next is a bizarre tale of burner phones and wild claims from the suspect, contrasting sharply with the victim's terrifying ordeal. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
